cross_surface_rules.rule: Final corpus is the canonical authority. Scroll editions, implementations, tests, vectors, Seer and public explanations do not become parallel top-level authority.

Do not globally replace the word canonical. Preserve domain-qualified meanings such as canonicalIndex, canonical API presentation, canonical service origin, or App canonical domain state when they do not assert calendar-semantic authority.
Canonical/textual edition provenance is distinct from semantic authority and website location. Exact quotations remain exact.
Test/generated vectors are canonical only if explicitly adopted as such.
No current numerical Venus-boundary implementation is a canonical numeric profile until GAP-ASTRO-MODEL is adjudicated.
Prior project decisions remain historical evidence; after corpus transition they are not parallel canon unless adopted into the corpus.

apply_gate: Never apply from this staging artifact alone to external/live repositories.
Re-fetch live target ref and compare blob/HEAD before any eventual patch.
Apply only findings supported by explicit adopted rules or after relevant corpus freeze.
Run target-specific invalidated tests; terminology agreement is not implementation conformance proof.
